questions.question_text: Read the unseen passage segment context about a lost hiker. According to the text, what was the first clear sign that helped the hiker locate the nearest village?
options: A) The sound of a loud horn
B) A column of thin white smoke rising above the pine trees
C) A glowing street lamp in the distance
D) Footprints on the muddy trail
questions.answer: B) A column of thin white smoke rising above the pine trees

questions.question_text: In the context of the passage, the phrase 'shivered uncontrollably' suggests that the hiker was feeling:
options: C) Deeply frightened or freezing cold
questions.answer: C) Deeply frightened or freezing cold

questions.question_text: Choose the synonym from the passage that means 'to search thoroughly':
questions.answer: B) Scavenge

questions.question_text: Based on the reading, explain briefly why the hiker decided to wait for dawn before moving further down the rocky slope. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The hiker decided to wait for dawn because the heavy darkness made the slippery, rocky slope extremely dangerous to climb down without proper visibility.

questions.question_text: What crucial lesson did the hiker learn about packing for outdoor adventures after this difficult experience? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The hiker learned the critical importance of always carrying a physical compass, waterproof matches, and a thermal blanket when exploring unfamiliar mountainous trails.

questions.question_text: Describe the emotional shift the hiker experienced when they finally heard the rescue dog barking. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: Initially filled with overwhelming despair and exhaustion from the freezing night, the hiker's emotions immediately shifted to profound relief and renewed hope upon hearing the distant barking of the rescue dog echoing through the quiet valley.

sections.section_name: Section B - Writing Skills & Applied Grammar

questions.question_text: Choose the correct option to change the sentence into the Passive Voice: 'The gardener is watering the plants.'
options: A) The plants are watered by the gardener.
B) The plants are being watered by the gardener.
C) The gardener was watering the plants.
D) The plants have been watered by the gardener.
questions.answer: B) The plants are being watered by the gardener.

questions.question_text: Select the correct indirect speech transformation for: The teacher said to the students, 'Do not make a noise.'
options: A) The teacher told the students that they do not make a noise.
B) The teacher asked the students not to make a noise.
C) The teacher said to the students do not make a noise.
D) The teacher ordered the students to not make a noise.
questions.answer: B) The teacher asked the students not to make a noise.

questions.question_text: Fill in the blank with the appropriate preposition: The frightened rabbit quickly hid _____ the dense thorny bushes.
questions.answer: B) among

questions.question_text: Identify the correct conjunction to join the two sentences: 'I wanted to buy the book. I did not have enough money.'
questions.answer: C) but

questions.question_text: Choose the correct option that demonstrates proper subject-verb agreement: 'Neither the principal nor the teachers ____ present at the morning assembly.'
questions.answer: C) were

questions.question_text: Identify the interjection in the following sentence: 'Alas! The beautiful antique vase has shattered into a thousand pieces.'
questions.answer: C) Alas

questions.question_text: Identify the type of adverb used in the sentence: 'The eager student answered the difficult question quite brilliantly.'
questions.answer: B) Adverb of Manner

questions.question_text: Rewrite the following sentence by punctuating it correctly and using capital letters where necessary: 'the taj mahal located in agra is a magnificent monument built by shah jahan' [15-25 words]
questions.answer: The Taj Mahal, located in Agra, is a magnificent monument built by Shah Jahan.

questions.question_text: Write a diary entry expressing your feelings after winning the first prize in an inter-school debate competition. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Dear Diary, Today was an unforgettable day! I participated in the inter-school debate competition and, to my sheer amazement, won the first prize. When my name was announced, my heart raced with immense joy. All my hard work and late-night preparations finally paid off. I feel incredibly proud and motivated. Good night!

questions.question_text: Write a formal application to the Principal of your school requesting a three-day leave to attend your elder sister's wedding in another city. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Respected Principal, I respectfully state that I am a student of Class 6 in your esteemed school. My elder sister's wedding is scheduled for next week in Jaipur. Therefore, I kindly request you to grant me leave for three days from the 10th to the 12th of November. I will be highly obliged. Yours obediently.

questions.question_text: Read the extract from 'The Kites': 'Up in the air they go, dancing with the wind.' What does the poet compare the movement of the kites to?
options: B) Dancers performing joyfully in the wind
D) Leaves falling from a tree
questions.answer: B) Dancers performing joyfully in the wind

questions.question_text: From the chapter 'Hamara Bharat Incredible India', which historical monument is primarily highlighted as a symbol of sacrifice?
questions.answer: C) The National War Memorial

questions.question_text: According to the chapter 'Spices that Heal Us', mention two common Indian spices that hold strong medicinal properties and state their basic uses. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: Turmeric is widely used to heal internal wounds and boost immunity due to its antibacterial properties. Ginger is commonly used to effectively treat severe colds, soothe sore throats, and aid digestion.

questions.question_text: In the story 'Change of Heart', what specific event triggered the transformation in the cruel king's behavior towards his subjects? [30-40 words]
questions.answer: The cruel king's heart changed when he witnessed a poor, frail old woman selflessly sharing her only piece of dry bread with a starving stray dog despite her own severe hunger.

questions.question_text: Briefly explain the central message conveyed through the chapter 'Yoga A Way of Life'. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: The chapter conveys that Yoga is not just a physical exercise, but a holistic way of living that perfectly balances the mind, body, and spirit, promoting inner peace, sharp focus, and overall good health.

questions.question_text: Based on the biographical account of 'Ila Sachani Embroidering Dreams with Her Feet', describe the major physical challenge she faced during her childhood. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: Ila Sachani was born with a severe physical condition that left her hands completely paralyzed. She faced immense difficulty in performing basic daily tasks, unable to hold objects or write like other children.

questions.question_text: Analyze the character of Ila Sachani. How does her journey from being unable to use her hands to becoming a master embroiderer inspire us to overcome life's obstacles? [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Ila Sachani's journey is a powerful testament to human resilience. Despite paralyzed hands, she refused to accept defeat. By training her feet to hold the needle, she mastered intricate Kathiawari embroidery through sheer determination and relentless practice. Her story inspires us to focus on our hidden strengths rather than our limitations to achieve greatness.

questions.question_text: In 'The Winner', winning is not always about coming first in a race. Describe the true definition of a winner as portrayed in the story, focusing on the values of empathy and sportsmanship. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: The story beautifully illustrates that a true winner is someone who shows deep empathy and outstanding sportsmanship. When the lead runner stopped to help a fallen competitor cross the finish line together, he sacrificed the gold medal but won everyone's hearts. True victory lies in compassion, teamwork, and helping others succeed, not just personal glory.
